_comment: Section 5 budgets of VISUAL_UPGRADE_PLAN.md for tools/art/audit_assets.py. Categories are tried in order; the first whose glob matches the repo-relative path wins (fnmatch: * also matches /). triangles = LOD0 triangles over the default scene; texture_px = largest image side. Rows marked provisional have no Section 5 line and borrow the nearest one.
